description: ODS V3 Pre-Release: Public testing and refinement ahead of the official V3 launch. Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into a private AI server.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

ODS is a fully local AI stack (LLM inference, chat, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, image generation, privacy tools) deployed on user hardware with a single command. It supports Linux (NVIDIA + AMD), Windows (WSL2), and macOS (Apple Silicon). The project is primarily Bash (installer/CLI), Python (dashboard-api, services), and React/Vite (dashboard UI).
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
